---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem or limitation you're running into. Focus on the *why*
before the *what*.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. If you have a specific approach in mind,
describe it — but it's fine to just describe the outcome you want.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't prefer them.

## Additional context

Is this related to something already listed in the README's
[TODO](../../README.md#todo) section? If so, link it — that list tracks known
gaps and deferred roadmap items.
